name: RevealUI starter
description: Clone the starter onto your Vercel account. RevealUI runtime on Vercel and Neon you control. Not managed hosting. Not the Starter Kit. Not a studio invoice.
envDescription: RevealUI runtime on Vercel and Neon you control. REVEALUI_SECRET must be 32+ characters. Neon injects DATABASE_URL, which RevealUI accepts as a POSTGRES_URL fallback. Set the public URL to this project after the first deploy.
